## Download

| Your device | Download |
| --- | --- |
| **Mac** (Intel or Apple silicon) | `Granite-Mac.dmg` |
| **Windows** | `Granite-Windows-Setup.exe` |
| **Android phone** | `Granite-Android.apk` |

iPhone and Linux are not available yet.

## First time you open it

Granite is in early beta and the builds are unsigned, so your system will warn you once. That is expected.

- **Mac:** open the `.dmg` and drag Granite to Applications. If macOS says it is from an unidentified developer, right-click the app → **Open** → **Open**.
- **Windows:** run the `.exe`. If SmartScreen says it protected your PC, click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **Android:** open the `.apk` on your phone. Android will ask you to allow **Install unknown apps** for your browser or file manager, because Granite is not on Google Play yet.

Found a problem? [Tell us](https://github.com/fishinglol/grantie/issues).
